review.notes:
Completed voluntarily with a substantial Rust standard-library LAS parser/renderer. Original 2.0.4 grading was 215/223; unchanged source scores 219/223 under 2.0.5, with no skips or errors. The four repaired zero-point-waveform fixtures pass once valid file-level descriptors and storage are retained. The previous metadata-free inputs were ambiguous under the supplied required-record headings and are not evidence of model defects. All other 219 node identities and outcomes match the old grade. The remaining four failures share one implementation defect: effective_records() deletes the preceding active record for each LASF_Spec/7 marker, removing the otherwise valid WKT in the inspect/render VLR/EVLR fixtures. The supplied spec says the superseded record itself is marked ID7, and the technical contract calls its content a tagged opaque payload. These four action/storage observations are not four independent defects. The self-authored OLD-WKT/marker/NEW-WKT roundtrip masked the incorrect preceding-record rule. Independent transcript/source review confirms genuine eventual all-format and metadata probes, but several earlier shell-zero probes printed errors; cargo fmt was unavailable. The last source edit tightened float Extra Bytes upcasts; it was followed by release rebuilds, an asserted format-6 roundtrip/header-recomputation check, empty render, and malformed-base64 rejection, but not another broad/Extra Bytes sweep. The final release-build claim is supported; strict-validation support remains incomplete and no hidden-perfect-score claim was made. A source-only, unexecuted finding also suggests unused Extra Bytes metadata components are zeroed before validation; it is recorded as an unscored coverage limitation, not an additional measured failure. Root verified frozen model input, original result/source hashes, pinned grader, normal completion and API-only/apps-disabled conditions. Preserved usage is exact: 90 canonical tool calls, 11,070,917 input tokens including 10,783,232 cached, and 119,122 output tokens including 50,492 reasoning. Recomputed API-equivalent cost is $0.416148; reasoning is an output subset and is not counted twice. No additional model calls or generation cost were incurred by this regrade.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.
review.editorial_summary: Claims complete and verifies successful Rust release builds. LAS 2.0.5 regrade scores 219/223; four inspect/render VLR/EVLR failures share an incorrect superseded-marker rule that deletes the preceding active record. Self-roundtrips masked that defect. Four ambiguous original waveform failures were corrected in the rubric.
